rows.mechanism_and_interactions: The brief asks for a source-grounded crossing of nonhuman body mechanics against many life-sim feature families. Its six body dimensions are verbs, senses, action clock, needs, social channel and ending; each source is to distinguish shown, stated and inferred mechanics, then derive lessons, failure modes, idle-time fit and adjacent body ideas. This is a research specification, not findings or an implemented mechanic.
